scope: For one captured ASCII HATCH/LWPOLYLINE pair in a source no larger than 16 KiB, retain a narrow AC1024 HEADER and model-space table/block identity check bound to the same source bytes. No association replay is enabled.
controls: A locally authored full AC1024 model-space drawing passes the source check.
Wrong model record, version, block owner, duplicate version, nonempty model block, modified source, conflicting source roles and corrected same-filter retry are rejected or handled as applicable.
An ODA-converted peer imports with the raw-only compact MATERIAL fix; its 121 KiB source exceeds the capture bound and therefore does not receive model-space evidence.
Existing mixed IMAGE/MATERIAL and bundled-codec HATCH controls pass.
limits: Exact selected field order and defaults only; independent native producer semantics are not established.
The check does not prove complete source graph closure, source geometry correspondence, final output or editing.
Source evidence alone does not enable replay or promote support claims.
fixtures: Locally authored drawings; no DXF or DWG committed
